verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner reflow, but the decorative circles become two stacked blobs stuck to the left edge, the 'SINGLE ORIGIN' label on the bag is too small to read, CITRINE floats at mid-height with no tie to the headline, and the CTA sits off-axis from the bag. A leaves about 88px empty at the right, and CITRINE sits tight against the green circle. B moves everything right, which leaves a dead gap between the circles and the logo and pushes the headline to about 32px from the right edge. That makes B slightly more lopsided, so A is a little better.
